doublehit.name: Double Hit
doublehit.desc: The user attacks with two strikes- one after the other.

karatechop.name: Karate Chop
karatechop.desc: The target is attacked with a sharp chop. This ALWAYS results in a critical hit.

slapndash.name: Slap N' Dash
slapndash.desc: The user playfully slaps the target's item away, hitting 2x before dashing away to switch places with a party member.

seismicfist.name: Seismic Fist
seismicfist.desc: A ground-breaking punch is thrown at the target. This has a 30% chance to drop the foe's Defense by 1.

goldrush.name: Gold Rush
goldrush.desc: The user flings gold at the opponent. This hits THREE times, with each hit having a 50% crit rate. Uses higher offensive stat.

firepunch.name: Fire Punch
firepunch.desc: The target is punched with a fiery fist. This has a 10% chance to burn the foe.

icepunch.name: Ice Punch
icepunch.desc: The target is punched with an icy fist. This has a 10% chance to freeze the foe. Contact.

thunderpunch.name: Thunder Punch
thunderpunch.desc: The target is punched with an electrified fist. This has a 10% chance to paralyze the foe.

metalclaw.name: Metal Claw
metalclaw.desc: The user rakes the target with claws, blades or the like hardened like steel. This ALWAYS results in a critical hit.

vicegrip.name: Vice Grip
vicegrip.desc: The target is gripped from both sides for 6 turns, preventing switching & dealing 12% of the foe's max HP per turn.

guillotine.name: Guillotine
guillotine.desc: The user brutally slices into the target with a razor-sharp blade or pincer- splitting it in two. ALWAYS crits, but can't be used 2x in a row.

chloroblast.name: Chloroblast
chloroblast.desc: The user charges for a turn, then fires all of its stored chlrophyll on the next turn. Boosts Sp. Atk after, always crits, no charge in sun.

swordsdance.name: Swords Dance
swordsdance.desc: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This raises the user's Attack by 2. Z-Effect gives +2 crit rate. -1 Priority.

furycutter.name: Fury Cutter
furycutter.desc: Will be finalized/revealed once the boss fight guide is filled out.

gust.name: Gust
gust.desc: A weak gust of wind is quickly whipped up and launched at the foe. This has +1 Priority.

dualwingbeat.name: Dual Wingbeat
dualwingbeat.desc: The user strikes the foe twice with its wings. Each strike has a 15% chance to flinch.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.desc: The user rapidly whips up a turbulent whirlwind that forces the target out of battle for a random Pokemon. Z-Effect +1 Speed.

fly.name: Fly
fly.desc: The user soars and then strikes its target on the next turn. This boosts Accuracy by 1 after use, & bypasses protect.

hydrofang.name: Hydro Fang
hydrofang.desc: The user tears into the target with fangs of churning water. This has a 20% flinch rate.

whiplash.name: Whiplash
whiplash.desc: The target is slammed with a long tail, arms, vines, or the like. This ALWAYS drops the foe's Defense.

vinelashes.name: Vine Lashes
vinelashes.desc: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines. This hits twice, lowering Defense each hit. (Roughly 81 BP on 1st use, 108 on 2nd, 118, etc)

stepon.name: Step-On
stepon.desc: The user steps on the target with graceful yet commanding force. This ALWAYS flinches the target.

doublekick.name: Double Kick
doublekick.desc: The target is kicked twice in succession using both legs.

megatonkick.name: Megaton Kick
megatonkick.desc: The user launches a kick towards the ground with massive force. This ALWAYS lowers the foe's Defense.

highjumpkick.name: High Jump Kick
highjumpkick.desc: The target is attacked with a reckless jumping kick. If this misses, the user loses 10% of its max HP.

rollingkick.name: Rolling Kick
rollingkick.desc: The user lashes out with a quick, spinning kick, switching itself out of battle afterwards.

sandsling.name: Sand Sling
sandsling.desc: The user flings sand at the foe's eyes, provoking them into attacking for 3 turns. +4 Priority, flinches, only works turn 1. Boosted in sand.

headbutt.name: Headbutt
headbutt.desc: The user tackles the foe head-first. This has a 30% flinch chance.

snipeshot.name: Snipe Shot
snipeshot.desc: The user takes aim at the target's weak point before firing a rapid blast of water. +4 Priority. Crits, boosts Acc, can't be used 2x in a row.

spikecannon.name: Spike Cannon
spikecannon.desc: Sharp, hard spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. This hit 2-5 times in a row.

hyperdrill.name: Hyper Drill
hyperdrill.desc: The user spins at high-speeds towards the opponent. Always crits, and has +4 Priority on the first turn. Matches user type.

pummel.name: Pummel
pummel.desc: The user pummels the foe repeatedly. This hits 2-5 times in a row.

bodyslam.name: Body Slam
bodyslam.desc: The user slams its body onto the foe. This has a 30% chance to paralyze.

constrict.name: Constrict
constrict.desc: The target is squeezed for 8 turns, preventing switching & dealing 12% of the foe's max HP per turn.

takedown.name: Take Down
takedown.desc: The user physically bombards the target. The user takes 20% recoil damage. Lowers the foe's Defense 30% of the time.

kerfuffle.name: Kerfuffle
kerfuffle.desc: The user barrels into the target in a boisterous scuffle. This deals 30% recoil and has a 50% chance to lower the target’s Defense.

doubleedge.name: Double-Edge
doubleedge.desc: A reckless, life-risking tackle. The user takes 30% recoil damage. This has a 50% chance to lower the foe's Defense.

tailwag.name: Tail Wag
tailwag.desc: The user wags its tail cutely, making foes less wary, dropping their Speed and defensive stats by 1. Z-Effect +1 Attack.

poisondart.name: Poison Dart
poisondart.desc: The user quickly shoots out a poisonous barb. This has +1 Priority.

barbbarrage.name: Barb Barrage
barbbarrage.desc: The user rapidly shoots venomous barbs at the target. This hits 2-5 times, and ALWAYS poisons.

pinmissile.name: Pin Missile
pinmissile.desc: Sharp, chitinous spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. This hit 2-5 times in a row.

leer.name: Leer
leer.desc: The user makes an intimidating glance at the opponent, dropping Defense and Speed by 1. Z-Effect +1 Atk.

jaggedfangs.name: Jagged Fangs
jaggedfangs.desc: The user bites the foe with jagged, hard teeth or fangs. This has a 30% chance to flinch.

growl.name: Growl
growl.desc: The user growls, dropping the foe's speed & offense stats by 1. Z-Effect gives +1 Attack.

roar.name: Roar
roar.desc: The user scares the target out of battle with a menacing roar. This has +4 Priority. Z-Effect +1 Sp. Atk.

sing.name: Sing
sing.desc: Singing a soothing lullaby, the target is put to sleep for 2 turns. Z-Effect: Center of attention.

pendulumwave.name: Pendulum Wave
pendulumwave.desc: Hypno swings its pendulum, firing a hypnotic wave that lulls the target to sleep for THREE turns. +4 Priority. Z-Effect heals Hypno.

sonicboom.name: Sonic Boom
sonicboom.desc: The user launches 3 powerful, loud shock waves through the air in rapid succession.

disable.name: Disable
disable.desc: For four turns, this move prevents the target from using the move it last used. Z-Effect +1 Sp. Def.

causticacid.name: Caustic Acid
causticacid.desc: The user sprays the foes with acid so harsh that it nullifies their ability, and lowers their Sp. Def by 2.

ignite.name: Ignite
ignite.desc: The user quickly ignites and shoots a weak flame. This has +1 Priority.

flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
flamethrower.desc: The user fires a beam of flames from its body. This burns the target 10% of the time.

chillout.name: Chill Out
chillout.desc: The user cools itself in a refreshing, frosty mist. Heals 50% HP. Heals 2/3 in snow, and only 1/3 in the sun. Z-Effect grants +1 Sp. Def.

watergun.name: Water Gun
watergun.desc: The user fires a concentrated stream of water faster than the target can react. +1 Priority.

hydropump.name: Hydro Pump
hydropump.desc: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure. This ALWAYS lowers the foe's Sp. Def.

surf.name: Surf
surf.desc: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave of water. Boosted by 50% under Lunar Aura.

icebeam.name: Ice Beam
icebeam.desc: A frozen beam of energy is shot at the target. This has a 10% chance to freeze the foe.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.desc: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opponents. This has a 10% chance to freeze the foe. Never misses in the snow.

influx.name: Influx
influx.desc: The user fires a psychic beam faster than the opponent can react. This has +1 priority.

bubbleburst.name: Bubble Burst
bubbleburst.desc: The user releases a beam of bubbles that pop on impact, slowing the target. ALWAYS lowers the foe's Speed by 2.

aurorabeam.name: Aurora Beam
aurorabeam.desc: The target is hit with a beautiful beam of frozen light. Lowers the foe's offensive stats, once per target.

hyperbeam.name: Hyper Beam
hyperbeam.desc: The user puts all of its energy into a powerful beam. This drops the user's Sp. Atk by 2 after use.

furypecks.name: Fury Pecks
furypecks.desc: The user furiously jabs at the target in sucession. This hits 2-5 times in a row.

drillpeck.name: Drill Peck
drillpeck.desc: A corkscrewing attack with a sharp appendage acting as a drill. This attack has a 50% (+2) crit rate.

submission.name: Submission
submission.desc: The user relentlessly beats the target into hopeless submission. This deals 50% recoil damage.

lowkick.name: Low Kick
lowkick.desc: The user kicks the foe's legs, tripping it, lowering their Speed by 2. The heavier the foe, the stronger this becomes.

counter.name: Counter
counter.desc: The user moves last, dealing 2x damage taken from any Physical Attack back to the target.

ancientimpact.name: Ancient Impact
ancientimpact.desc: The user taps into its primal energy, dealing damage equal to user level. Boosts Sp. Atk/Acc by 2. +4 Priority, flinches, only works turn 1.

thrash.name: Thrash
thrash.desc: The user thrashes violently, expending all of its energy. This deals 50% recoil damage, and ALWAYS lowers Defense.

siphon.name: Siphon
siphon.desc: The user siphons the target's life force. The user's HP is restored by 100% of the damage dealt.

megadrain.name: Mega Drain
megadrain.desc: A nutrient-draining attack. This user's HP is restored by 75% of the damage dealt.

leechseed.name: Leech Seed
leechseed.desc: A seed is planted on the target. It steals 12% HP from the target every turn. Z-Effect gives +3 Accuracy.

growth.name: Growth
growth.desc: The user's body grows, raising its Attack and Sp. Atk by 1, or 2 under the Sun. Z-Effect heals user fully.

razorleaf.name: Razor Leaf
razorleaf.desc: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at the foes. This ALWAYS results in a critical hit.

solarbeam.name: Solar Beam
solarbeam.desc: The user gathers light, then blasts a beam on the next turn. Doesn't need to charge in the Sun.

poisonpowder.name: Poison Powder
poisonpowder.desc: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust that poisons the target. Z-Effect gives +1 Sp. Def.

stunspore.name: Stun Spore
stunspore.desc: The user scatters a cloud of numbing powder that paralyzes the target. Z-Effect +1 Sp. Def.

sleeppowder.name: Sleep Powder
sleeppowder.desc: The user scatters a big cloud of sleep inducing dust, putting the target to sleep for 2 turns. Z-Effect heals the user fully.

petaldance.name: Petal Dance
petaldance.desc: The user performs a dance while cloaked in petals. Boosts offenses, & uses whichever stat is higher. Can't be used 2x in a row.

stringshot.name: String Shot
stringshot.desc: The user entangles the target in layers of sticky silk, making them vulnerable. This lowers Speed by 2 and defensive stats by 1. Z-Effect: Fully heals the user.

dragonburst.name: Dragon Burst
dragonburst.desc: The user releases 3 concentrated shockwave of draconic energy in rapid succession. This hits 3 times.

firespin.name: Fire Spin
firespin.desc: The target becomes trapped within a vortex of fire that traps foe for 8 turns, preventing switching and dealing 12% of the foe's HP.

triplejolt.name: Triple Jolt
triplejolt.desc: The user fires off 3 rapid jolts of electricity in succession.

thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
thunderbolt.desc: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This leaves the target paralyzed 10% of the time.

thunderwave.name: Thunder Wave
thunderwave.desc: The user launches a weak wave of electricity that paralyzes the target. Paralysis has been buffed. Z-Effect +1 Sp. Def.

thunder.name: Thunder
thunder.desc: A loud, wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target. This has a 30% chance to paralyze. Never misses if it is raining.

sugarrush.name: Sugar Rush
sugarrush.desc: The user hurls crystallized sugar, making the foe restless- changing their ability to Insomnia. +4 priority, flinches but only works turn 1.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.desc: The user causes the ground to quake violently, striking everything nearby with powerful seismic force.

fissure.name: Fissure
fissure.desc: The user splits the earth beneath the target apart with tremendous force. The exertion lowers the user’s Attack by 2, however.

dig.name: Dig
dig.desc: The user burrows, aims for the target, then attacks on the next turn. This boosts Accuracy by 1 after use, & bypasses protect.

toxic.name: Toxic
toxic.desc: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn, starting at 6% and increasing by 6% each turn. Z-Effect: +1 Sp. Def.

mindpulse.name: Mind Pulse
mindpulse.desc: The user unleashes a telekinectic pulse that impacts the mind. Drops the foe's offensive stats, once per target.

psychic.name: Psychic
psychic.desc: The target is hit a strong telekinetic force. This drops the foe's Sp. Def 25% of the time.

hypnosis.name: Hypnosis
hypnosis.desc: The user employs hypnotic suggestion, putting the target to sleep for 2 turns. Z-Effect +1 Accuracy.

meditate.name: Meditate
meditate.desc: The users meditates, relaxing its mind. Heals to full HP, curing status too- but makes the user fall asleep 2 turns after. Z-Effect: Center of attention.

agility.name: Agility
agility.desc: The users relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This raises the user's Speed by 2. Z-Effect +2 Crit Rate. -1 Priority.

quickattack.name: Quick Attack
quickattack.desc: The user dashes at the target quickly. This has +1 Priority.

rage.name: Rage
rage.desc: The user's rage builds. As long as this move is in use, the user's Attack goes up by 1 each time the user is hit. Matches user type.

teleport.name: Teleport
teleport.desc: The user teleports, switching places with a party member in waiting. -6 Priority. Z-Effect heals replacement fully.

soulabsorb.name: Soul Absorb
soulabsorb.desc: The user absorbs the foe's life force. This deals damage equal to the user's level, and recovers HP equal to the user's level.

mimic.name: Mimic
mimic.desc: The user copies the target's last move and can use it during battle until they switch out. +6 Priority. Z-Effect +1 All Stats.

screech.name: Screech
screech.desc: An earsplitting screech that lowers all foe's defensive stats by 2 stages. Z-Effect +1 Sp. Atk.

watershuriken.name: Water Shuriken
watershuriken.desc: The user fires shurikens made of water. This has +4 priority only on the first turn, and hits 2-5 times.

recover.name: Recover
recover.desc: Restoring its own cells, the user restores its own HP by half of its max HP. Z-Effect +1 Sp. Def.

concentrate.name: Concentrate
concentrate.desc: The user concentrates, raising its Sp. Def stat by 1. Z-Effect heals the user fully.

sleepmode.name: Sleep Mode
sleepmode.desc: The users powers down. Heals to full HP and cures status, but the user falls asleep at the end of the 2nd full turn after using it. Z-Effect: +1 Sp. Atk.

contaminate.name: Contaminate
contaminate.desc: The user expels a germ-riddled gas that changes the opponents into pure Poison types. Z-Effect gives +1 Sp. Atk.

eeriewave.name: Eerie Wave
eeriewave.desc: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that lowers Sp. Atk by -2. Z-Effect +1 Sp. Atk.

withdraw.name: Withdraw
withdraw.desc: The user withdraws into its hard shell, raising both defensive stats by 1. Z-Effect heals the user fully.

defensecurl.name: Defense Curl
defensecurl.desc: The user curls up its body to raise its Defense stat by 1. Z-Effect heals the user fully.

barrier.name: Barrier
barrier.desc: The user throws up an invisible wall, raising its Defense stat by 2. Z-Effect heals the user fully.

lightscreen.name: Light Screen
lightscreen.desc: A wondrous wall of light is put up to halve damage from Special Attacks for 5 turns. Critical hits no longer ignore Light Screen. Z-Effect: Fully heals the user.

darkhaze.name: Dark Haze
darkhaze.desc: The user releases a thick, black smog that clears all stat changes for every Pokemon on the field. Z-Effect heals to full.

reflect.name: Reflect
reflect.desc: A wondrous wall of light is put up to halve damage from Physical Attacks for 5 turns. Critical hits no longer ignore Reflect. Z-Effect: Fully heals the user.

focusenergy.name: Focus Energy
focusenergy.desc: The user itensifies its focus. This gives +2 crit rate, making standard moves crit 50% of the time. Z-Effect gives +1 Speed.

bide.name: Bide
bide.desc: The user endures attacks for 2 turns, then strikes back double the damage taken with +1 priority on the 3rd turn.

metronome.name: Metronome
metronome.desc: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move. Z-Effect boosts all stats by +1 before using the random Z-move.

mirrormove.name: Mirror Move
mirrormove.desc: The user counters the target by mimicking the target’s last move. Z-Effect +2 Attack. This has +6 Priority.

detonate.name: Detonate
detonate.desc: The user blows itself up in a fiery explosion, fainting themselves. This ALWAYS burns, bypasses Protect & uses the higher stat.

eggcannon.name: Egg Cannon
eggcannon.desc: The user launches 3 eggs at high-power. Matches user type. However, this cannot be used 2x in a row.

deviouslick.name: Devious Lick
deviouslick.desc: The user's tongue sends a numbing chill throughout the foe's body. ALWAYS flinches & paralyzes. +4 Priority on the first turn only.

decompose.name: Decompose
decompose.desc: The user emits fumes that break down living tissue, absorbing 100% of damage dealt. Power doubles if the opponent is below half HP.

sludgefling.name: Sludge Fling
sludgefling.desc: The user hurls thick, gooey sludge at the target. This ALWAYS lowers the foe's Speed by 2.

boneclub.name: Bone Club
boneclub.desc: The user catches the foe off guard with a sudden swing of its bone. Always flinches, has +4 priority, but only works turn 1. Hits airborne opponents for neutral.

fireblast.name: Fire Blast
fireblast.desc: The target is attacked with an intense blast of flames. This ALWAYS leaves the target burnt.

wavecrash.name: Wave Crash
wavecrash.desc: The user surges towards the foe with the force of a tsunami. This deals 30% recoil to the user, and has a 30% flinch rate.

clampdown.name: Clamp Down
clampdown.desc: The user clamps down on the foe before they can react. ALWAYS flinches, and traps for 8 turns- gains +4 priority on turn 1 only.

swift.name: Swift
swift.desc: Star-shaped rays are rapidly shot at the foe. This has +1 Priority.

skullbash.name: Skull Bash
skullbash.desc: The user tucks its head in, raising Def- then rams the foe on the 2nd turn, raising Atk/Acc. Matches user type. 30% Recoil.

burningbarrage.name: Burning Barrage
burningbarrage.desc: The user fires a barrage of flaming projectiles. This hits 2-5 times, and ALWAYS burns.

vinewrap.name: Vine Wrap
vinewrap.desc: The target is wrapped with long vines for 8 turns, preventing switching & dealing 12% of the foe's max HP per turn.

amnesia.name: Amnesia
amnesia.desc: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This raises the user's Sp. Def by 2. Z-Effect heals the user fully.

brainfreeze.name: Brainfreeze
brainfreeze.desc: The user gives the target terrible brainfreeze- turning them into an Ice type before attacking, & flinching. +4 Priority. Only works turn 1.

softboiled.name: Soft-Boiled
softboiled.desc: The user draws healing energy from their held egg- healing to full. With Z-Power, they are able to move faster after draining their egg.

divebomb.name: Divebomb
divebomb.desc: The user recklessly dives onto the target from above. If this misses, the user loses 10% of its max HP.

glare.name: Glare
glare.desc: The user transfixes the target with a menacing gaze, paralyzing them with fear and lowering offensive stats. Z-Effect +1 Sp. Atk.

braindrain.name: Brain Drain
braindrain.desc: The user feeds on the target's thoughts- healing itself by 50% of damage dealt.

poisongas.name: Poison Gas
poisongas.desc: The user exposes the target to a toxic gas that weakens them over time. Drops offensive stats and poisons. Z-Effect +1 Sp. Atk.

triplecannonade.name: Triple Cannonade
triplecannonade.desc: The user fires heavy artillery in succession, hitting 3 times. Can't be used twice in a row.

leechlife.name: Leech Life
leechlife.desc: The user drains the target's vital fluids. The user's HP is restored by 50% of the damage dealt.

gloomykiss.name: Gloomy Kiss
gloomykiss.desc: The user delivers a haunting kiss, sending the target into a slumber for 2 turns and turning them pure Ghost. Z-Effect Follow Me.

skyattack.name: Sky Attack
skyattack.desc: The user ascends on the 1st turn, crashing down with tremendous energy on the 2nd. Boosts Atk/Accuracy after, & ALWAYS crits.

mewgenics.name: Mewgenics
mewgenics.desc: The user copies the genetic code of the opponent, transforming into them. +6 Priority. Z-Effect heals to full.

dribbledrain.name: Dribble Drain
dribbledrain.desc: The user splashes the foes with small water droplets that sap away vitality. Heals ALL damage dealt.

dizzyingpunches.name: Dizzying Punches
dizzyingpunches.desc: The user strikes with 3 confounding, unpredictable punches. Hits 3x and confuses the opponent for 3 turns. No use 2x in a row.

spore.name: Spore
spore.desc: The user scatters bursts of spores that put the target to sleep for 2 turns. Z-Effect +1 Sp. Def.

flash.name: Flash
flash.desc: The user flashes a strange light that wipes the foe's memory, causing them to forget their last used move for 15 turns. +6 Priority. Z-Effect +3 Sp. Def.

brainwave.name: Brainwave
brainwave.desc: The user fires off a brainwave faster than the target can think. +4 Priority on turn 1 only. Deals 1.5x damage if foe is asleep.

metalmaw.name: Metal Maw
metalmaw.desc: The user crushes the target between steel-hard jaws. This has a 30% chance to lower the target's Defense.

acidarmor.name: Acid Armor
acidarmor.desc: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, raising its Defense stat by 2 stages. Z-Effect heals the user fully.

crabhammer.name: Crabhammer
crabhammer.desc: The user slams its claw down with full force. This ALWAYS crits, but can't be used 2x in a row.

explosion.name: Explosion
explosion.desc: The user explodes, devastating everything around it, fainting itself. Uses higher offensive stat. ALWAYS crits & ignores protect.

furyswipes.name: Fury Swipes
furyswipes.desc: The target is raked furiously with sharp claws, scythes, or the like. This hits 2-5 times in a row.

bonemerang.name: Bonemerang
bonemerang.desc: The user hurls a bone like a bonemerang, striking twice in one turn. 30% flinch. Hits airborne targets neutrally.

rest.name: Rest
rest.desc: The user rests, falling alseep for 3 turns after healing to full HP and curing any status inflictions. Z-Effect gives +2 Sp. Def.

rockslide.name: Rock Slide
rockslide.desc: The user readies itself, and sends a mass of rocks crashing down at the target. This usually moves last. (-5 Priority)

hyperfang.name: Hyper Fang
hyperfang.desc: The user bites down hard with its specialized front teeth. This always crits, but can't be used 2x in a row.

fortify.name: Fortify
fortify.desc: The user fortifies the metal on its body. This heals the user by 50% of their max HP. Z-Effect gives +1 Defense.

conversion.name: Conversion
conversion.desc: The user changes its type to become the type of the move at the top of its moveset. +2 Priority. Z-Effect +1 All Stats.

triattack.name: Tri Attack
triattack.desc: The user shoots three volatile beams. Hits 3 times, with each hit having a 10% chance to burn, paralyze or freeze. No 2x in a row.

superfang.name: Super Fang
superfang.desc: The user bites down on the target before they can react. This has +4 priority and flinches, but can only be used turn 1.

slash.name: Slash
slash.desc: The user slashes the target with sharp claws, blades, or the like. This has a +2 (50%) critical hit rate.

substitute.name: Substitute
substitute.desc: The user makes a decoy using 25% of its HP. This decoy can absorb most attacks for the user. Z-Effect heals the user.

struggle.name: Struggle
struggle.desc: This attack is used in desperation only if the user has no PP. It has 50% recoil for the user.

sketch.name: Sketch
sketch.desc: Smeargle permanantly learns the move last used by the target. Once used, Sketch disappears. +7 Priority. Z-Effect gives +1 all stats.

triplekick.name: Triple Kick
triplekick.desc: The user kicks the foe 3 times in rapid sucession with incredible skill & precision- ALWAYS critting. (15, 30 and 45 per hit.)

thief.name: Thief
thief.desc: The user sneakily attacks, stealing the target's held item. No item is stolen if user has an item already. 1.5x damage if an item is stolen.

spiderweb.name: Spider Web
spiderweb.desc: The user suddenly ensnares the target in its web, making it flinch and lowering its Speed by 2. +4 Priority, only works turn 1.

lookout.name: Look-Out
lookout.desc: The user quickly flashes its eyes, stunning the foe before switching out. Paralyzes, drops Atk/Sp. Atk by 1. Z-Effect: Heals the replacement.

nightterror.name: Night Terror
nightterror.desc: The user jolts a sleeping target with a sudden, scary vision. This has +4 priority, always flinches, but only works if the foe is asleep. Matches user type.

flamewheel.name: Flame Wheel
flamewheel.desc: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target spinning. This ALWAYS boosts the user's Speed.

snore.name: Snore
snore.desc: This obnoxious noise can only be used if the user is asleep, but ALWAYS flinches. Matches user type. +4 Priority if used on turn 1.

curse.name: Curse
curse.desc: The user places a curse on the opponent, laying down 50% of its own HP to deal 25% HP per turn to the afflicted target. Z-Heals.

flail.name: Flail
flail.desc: The user flails about desperately. The less HP the user has, the greater the move's power, maxing out at 200 BP.

arcanefangs.name: Arcane Fangs
arcanefangs.desc: The user sinks its teeth into the target, pulsing with mysterious draconic energy as it absorbs its vitality. Heals 50% damage dealt.

aeroblast.name: Aeroblast
aeroblast.desc: A fierce vortex of air is shot at the target. This lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2 after use, however.

cottonspore.name: Cotton Spore
cottonspore.desc: The user coats the target in a layer of fuzz. This turns them pure Grass type & lowers Speed/Evasion by 2. Z-Effect gives +1 Defense.

reversal.name: Reversal
reversal.desc: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has, capping at 200 BP.

soulshed.name: Soul Shed
soulshed.desc: Shedinja leaves part of itself behind, draining the target's soul- dropping their offensive stats before leaving battle. +4 Priority. Z: Heals replacement.

frostflurry.name: Frost Flurry
frostflurry.desc: The user attacks with a rapid flurry of snow. This has +1 Priority.

protect.name: Protect
protect.desc: Enables the user to evade all attacks. Cannot be used 2x in a row. Z-Effect resets lowered stats.

machpunch.name: Mach Punch
machpunch.desc: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. This has +1 Priority.

scaryface.name: Scary Face
scaryface.desc: The user frightens the target with a terrifying expression, lowering their Atk & Defense by 1 stage. Z-Effect +1 Attack.

cheapshot.name: Cheap Shot
cheapshot.desc: The user mercilessly exploits the target's vulnerability. An opponent with a status condition takes double damage from this attack.

dreamykiss.name: Dreamy Kiss
dreamykiss.desc: The user gives the target an enchanting kiss, soothing them to sleep for 2 turns. Z-Effect gives +1 Accuracy.

bellydrum.name: Belly Drum
bellydrum.desc: The user vigorously bangs on its chest or belly. This gives +6 Attack in exchange for 50% of their max HP. Z-Effect heals user.

sludgebomb.name: Sludge Bomb
sludgebomb.desc: The user hurls unsanitary sludge, exploding all over the target. This poisons 30% of the time.

mudshot.name: Mud Shot
mudshot.desc: The user quickly fires a compact clump of mud before the target can react. This has +1 priority.

scumshot.name: Scum Shot
scumshot.desc: The user catches the foe off guard, firing thick, dark sludge, leaving them badly poisoned. +4 Priority, flinches but only works on turn 1.

spikes.name: Spikes
spikes.desc: The user lays spikes at the foe's side. This damages grounded foes when switching in, for 12-25% of their HP. Z-Effect +1 Attack.

zapcannon.name: Zap Cannon
zapcannon.desc: The user fires off a massive electric blast. Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2 after use, however.

scorchingsands.name: Scorching Sands
scorchingsands.desc: The user engulfs the target in a wave of searing-hot sand. This ALWAYS burns, and is boosted by 50% in a sandstorm.

destinybond.name: Destiny Bond
destinybond.desc: A Pokemon that knocks out the user also faints if this move was used. +4 Priority. Z-Effect makes the user the center of attention.

perishsong.name: Perish Song
perishsong.desc: Any Pokemon that hears this sound faints in 5 turns. Switching out removes the timer- but the AI does not switch. Z-Effect heals.

icywind.name: Icy Wind
icywind.desc: The user attacks with a gust of freezing air. This ALWAYS lowers the foe's Speed stat by 2.

burningbulwark.name: Burning Bulwark
burningbulwark.desc: The user defends itself while heating itself up- burning any attackers who make contact while protected. No use 2x in a row. Z-Effect: +1 Defense.

bonerush.name: Bone Rush
bonerush.desc: The user swiftly tosses a bone before the target can react. Hits airborne targets neutrally. This has +1 Priority.

takeaim.name: Take-Aim
takeaim.desc: Will be finalized/revealed once the boss fight guide is filled out.

ragingfury.name: Raging Fury
ragingfury.desc: Will be finalized/revealed once the boss fight guide is filled out.

sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
sandstorm.desc: The user summons a raging sandstorm for 5 turns. Boosts Rock type's Sp. Def by 50%. Z-Effect gives +1 Sp. Def. Has +2 Priority.

gigadrain.name: Giga Drain
gigadrain.desc: A strong nutrient-draining attack. This user's HP is restored by 50% of the damage dealt.

endure.name: Endure
endure.desc: The user braces itself, surving an attack that would've knocked it out. Fails consecutively. Z-Effect makes user center of attention.

charm.name: Charm
charm.desc: The user fools the target by acting cute, making them less hostile. This drops Attack by 2 stages. Z-Effect +1 Attack.

rollout.name: Roll-Out
rollout.desc: The user rolls into the target at high speed, then uses its momentum to roll back & switch places with a party member.

papercut.name: Papercut
papercut.desc: Kartana slashes the foe with its paper blade. This ALWAYS crits, and is super-effective on Grass & Steel types.

baitnswitch.name: Bait N' Switch
baitnswitch.desc: The user provokes the target into attacking for 3 turns, then makes a quick getaway, switching with a party member. Z-Effect: Heals the replacement.

milkdrink.name: Milk Drink
milkdrink.desc: The user drinks its own supply of milk, and feeds its allies too! Heals 2/3 HP. With Z-Power, the user draws attention to itself.

spark.name: Spark
spark.desc: Charged with electricity, the user rapidly dashes at the foe. This has +1 Priority.

creepingstrike.name: Creeping Strike
creepingstrike.desc: The user creeps up on the target and strikes suddenly. This has +1 priority.

steelwingbeat.name: Steel Wingbeat
steelwingbeat.desc: The user batters the target twice with powerful steel-hard wings. Each strike lowers the target's Defense. (92 BP, 124 BP, 134 BP, etc)

mesmereyes.name: Mesmer-Eyes
mesmereyes.desc: The user mesmerizes the target with its eyes, putting them to sleep for 2 turns. Fails on Ghost-types. Z-Effect resets lowered stats.

luciddream.name: Lucid Dream
luciddream.desc: The user dreams so vividly, it uses one of its moves while alseep. This has +1 Priority. Z-Effect gives +1 Sp. Atk & turns into a Z-Attack.

healbell.name: Heal Bell
healbell.desc: The user rings its bell, chiming throughout the user's party. This cures status AND heals 50% throughout your entire party. Z-Effect: Resets lowered stats.

hoodwink.name: Hoodwink
hoodwink.desc: The user unleashes an unexpectedly vicious blow after putting on a cute act. 30% flinch rate.

specialdelivery.name: Special Delivery
specialdelivery.desc: Delibird gives the target 3 gifts with a hidden trap. When used on an ally, each hit heals them by 50% instead. Uses higher stat.

hitnrun.name: Hit N' Run
hitnrun.desc: The user attacks violently, then runs off before they can react. Switches the user out to another party member after attacking.

safeguard.name: Safeguard
safeguard.desc: The user guards its side of the field with a mysterious, protecive force. This blocks all stat drops on their side for 10 turns. Z-Heals.

painsplit.name: Pain Split
painsplit.desc: The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then equally divides that HP between itself and the foe. Z-Effect +1 Sp. Def.

infernalparade.name: Infernal Parade
infernalparade.desc: The user attacks with an infernal flame fueled by spiritual energy. This ALWAYS burns the target.

aftershock.name: Aftershock
aftershock.desc: The user destabilizes the ground until a violent seismic wave tears through it. This move usually strikes last. (-5 Priority)

knockoutpunch.name: Knockout Punch
knockoutpunch.desc: The user punches with immense power. The resulting fatigue causes the target to fall asleep (for 2 turns!) after the next turn.

megahorn.name: Megahorn
megahorn.desc: The user rams its impressive horn or pointed appendage into the target with no letup. This deals 50% recoil damage. 30% flinch rate.

dragonbreath.name: Dragon Breath
dragonbreath.desc: The user exhales intense breath crackling with dragon energy. This ALWAYS leaves the target paralyzed.

batonpass.name: Baton Pass
batonpass.desc: The user passes on any stat boosts it has to a party member. This ALWAYS goes last. Z-Effect heals the replacement fully.

encore.name: Encore
encore.desc: The user compels the target to keep using the move it last used for three turns. Z-Effect +1 Speed.

pursuit.name: Pursuit
pursuit.desc: This relentless attack DOUBLES in power if the foe attempts to switch that turn.

rapidspin.name: Rapid Spin
rapidspin.desc: The user performs a spin-attack, boosting Speed by 1 and clearing entry hazards, bindings and Leech Seed. Matches type of the user.

sweetscent.name: Sweet Scent
sweetscent.desc: The user soothes all opponents with a pleasant smell, lowering their fighting spirit. Drops Sp. Atk, Sp. Def & Evasion by 1. Z-Effect: Center of attention.

irontail.name: Iron Tail
irontail.desc: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This has a 50% chance to boost the user's Defense stat by 1.

laceration.name: Laceration
laceration.desc: The user brutally rends the target with hard, razor-sharp claws or blades, leaving deep wounds. This has a 50% (+2) crit rate.

skirmish.name: Skirmish
skirmish.desc: The user picks a fight and roughhouses the target. Drops both of the foe's offensive stats once per target.

morningsun.name: Morning Sun
morningsun.desc: The user heals itself by 50% of its max HP. This restores 2/3 HP in the Sun, and 1/3 HP in other weather. Z-Effect gives +1 Sp. Def.

synthesis.name: Synthesis
synthesis.desc: The user heals itself by 50% of its max HP. This restores 2/3 HP in the Sun, and 1/3 HP in other weather. Z-Effect gives +1 Sp. Def.

moonlight.name: Moonlight
moonlight.desc: The user draws power from the moon, healing itself by 50% HP. If Lunar Aura is active, heals 2/3 HP. Only heals 1/3 in sunlight. Z-Effect: +1 Sp. Def.

flashbang.name: Flashbang
flashbang.desc: The user releases a blinding burst of light. Matches the user's type, ALWAYS flinches, has +4 priority, but can only be used on turn 1.

crosschop.name: Cross Chop
crosschop.desc: The user delivers a powerful chop with two hands, blades, or the like. This has a 50% (+2) critical hit rate.

twister.name: Twister
twister.desc: The user whips up the air violenty. This is boosted by 50% if it is raining. 50% chance to confuse opponents.

raindance.name: Rain Dance
raindance.desc: The user does a dance to summon the rain. Z-Effect gives +1 Sp. Def, +2 Priority.

sunnyday.name: Sunny Day
sunnyday.desc: The user summons strong sunlight. Z-Effect gives +1 Sp. Def. +2 Priority.

crunch.name: Crunch
crunch.desc: The user bites down hard and violently onto the foe. This has a 30% chance to drop the foe's Defense.

mirrorcoat.name: Mirror Coat
mirrorcoat.desc: The user moves last, reflecting 2x damage taken from any Special Attack back to the target.

psychup.name: Psych Up
psychup.desc: Using psychic powers, the user copies any stat changes the target has. This has +4 Priority. Z-Effect heals user fully.

extremespeed.name: Extreme Speed
extremespeed.desc: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This has +3 Priority.

ancientpower.name: Ancient Power
ancientpower.desc: The user attacks with rocks imbued with a strange primal energy. Drops both of the foe's offensive stats once per target.

shadowball.name: Shadow Ball
shadowball.desc: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. This has a 30% chance to drop the target's Sp. Def.

futuresight.name: Future Sight
futuresight.desc: The user foresees a very powerful psychic blast that will strike the target 2 turns after the move is used.

boulderbash.name: Boulder Bash
boulderbash.desc: The user punches the foe with rock-shattering strength. This ALWAYS drops the foe's Defense stat by 1.

whirlpool.name: Whirlpool
whirlpool.desc: The user envelops the target in an intense whirlpool, trapping them in battle for 8 turns & dealing 12% of their HP per turn.

beatup.name: Beat Up
beatup.desc: Ganging up on the foe, this uses the user's Attack stat, but the BP of each hit is calculated with: (Party Member Base Attack/10) +5.

fakeout.name: Fake Out
fakeout.desc: The user fakes the target out, flinching them. Can only be used on the 1st turn. Has +5 Priority.

uproar.name: Uproar
uproar.desc: The user creates a boisterous ruckus. Confuses those who hear it. If the foes are asleep, this does 50% more- but wakes them up.

stockpile.name: Stockpile
stockpile.desc: The user stockpiles energy, which raises its Defense & Sp. Def stats by 1. This can only be used 3 times. Z-Effect heals user fully.

spewout.name: Spew Out
spewout.desc: The user upchucks its caustic stomach contents. For every Stockpile, this gains 100 BP. ALWAYS CRITS and drops Sp. Def by 2.

swallow.name: Swallow
swallow.desc: The user heals 1/3 for 1 stockpile, 1/2 for 2, and full HP for 3 stockpiles. This now has +4 priority. Z-Move gives +1 all stats. (Doesn't work with Simple.)

heatwave.name: Heat Wave
heatwave.desc: The user blows a burning, abrasive wind at the foes. This ALWAYS results in a critical hit. 10% burn rate.

snowscape.name: Snowscape
snowscape.desc: The user summons a snowstorm lasting 5 turns. Now boosts the Defense of Ice types. Z-Effect gives +1 Sp. Def. +2 Priority.

torment.name: Torment
torment.desc: The user torments and enrages the foe, making them incapable of using the same move twice in a row. Z-Effect gives +1 Accuracy.

curtaincall.name: Curtain Call
curtaincall.desc: The user calls for an encore before making its exit. The foe must repeat its last move, while the user switches to a party member. Z: Heals replacement.

willowisp.name: Will-O-Wisp
willowisp.desc: The user burns the target with an eerie flame. Z-Effect makes the user the center of attention.

bittermalice.name: Bitter Malice
bittermalice.desc: The user attacks with spine-chilling resentment. This ALWAYS lowers both offensive stats by 1, once per target.

facade.name: Facade
facade.desc: This attack's power is doubled if the user is burnt, poisoned or paralyzed. Contact.

icebreaker.name: Ice Breaker
icebreaker.desc: The user fires a ginormous icicle with great force. This is Super-Effective on Ice, ALWAYS crits, but can't be used 2x in a row.

smellingsalts.name: Smelling Salts
smellingsalts.desc: Hairyama smacks the foe, resuscitating them. ALWAYS flinches, 2x if the foe is paralyzed, curing it- gains +4 priority on turn 1 only.

followme.name: Follow Me
followme.desc: The user draws attention to itself, making all opponents only attack the user. Z-Effect heals user fully.

naturepower.name: Nature Power
naturepower.desc: This move changes into a different one depending on terrain. Works with regular terrains, Lunar Aura & Mudslide. Fails otherwise.

chargeup.name: Charge-Up
chargeup.desc: The user braces itself- enduring attacks while charging electricity. Any Electric moves used on the next turn deal 2x damage. Z-Effect: Center of attention.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.desc: The user taunts the foe into a rage that forces it to only use attacking moves for 3 turns. Z-Effect gives +1 Accuracy.

helpinghand.name: Helping Hand
helpinghand.desc: The user assists an ally, boosting the power of their attack by 50%. This has +7 priority. Z-Effect makes user center of attention.

trick.name: Trick
trick.desc: The user swaps the target's held item with their own. +4 Priority. Z-Effect becomes the center of attention.

roleplay.name: Role Play
roleplay.desc: The user copies the target's ability. Z-Effect gives +1 Speed.

wish.name: Wish
wish.desc: One turn after Wish is used, the user or its replacement's HP is restored by 50% of the user's HP. Z-Effect +1 Sp. Def.

catscradle.name: Cat's Cradle
catscradle.desc: Using its feline charm and reflexes, the user protects itself whilst drawing attention to itself. Z-Effect heals to full.

ingrain.name: Ingrain
ingrain.desc: The user roots itself into the ground, healing 1/6 HP per turn & blocking phasing, but also blocks switching without a pivot move. Z-Effect: +1 Sp. Def.

superpower.name: Superpower
superpower.desc: The user pushes its strength to the limit to deliver an overwhelming attack. In exchange, this lowers the user's Attack by 2 after use.

magiccoat.name: Magic Coat
magiccoat.desc: The user reflects back most targeted status moves at the foe. This ALWAYS moves first. Z-Effect makes user the center of attention.

recycle.name: Recycle
recycle.desc: The user recycles its held item. This only works if the user used up a held item. Z-Effect heals the user fully.

temperflare.name: Temper Flare
temperflare.desc: The user's anger flares up into a blazing tantrum. ALWAYS crits, 20% burn rate, 2x power if last move "failed."

brickbreak.name: Brick Break
brickbreak.desc: The user delivers a hard chop with any limb it can use. This removes any screens from the field and ALWAYS drops the foe's Defense.

yawn.name: Yawn
yawn.desc: The user yawns, making the foe drowsy. The foe will fall asleep at the end of the next turn. The sleep always lasts for 2 turns. Z: Full heal.

knockoff.name: Knock Off
knockoff.desc: The user hits the target's held item off, removing it until the end of battle. This deals 1.5x damage if it removes an item.

endeavor.name: Endeavor
endeavor.desc: The user makes a desperate attack, cutting down the foe's HP to equal the user's current HP.

eruption.name: Eruption
eruption.desc: The user attacks the foes with a furious blast of fire. The lower the user's HP, the lower this move's power. If full HP, this move is 150 BP.

skillswap.name: Skill Swap
skillswap.desc: The user's mysterious psychic power swaps the target's ability and the user's ability. Z-Effect makes user the center of attention.

artistsblock.name: Artist's Block
artistsblock.desc: Smeargle disables the opponent from using any moves it currently knows. Z-Effect makes the user the center of attention.

molt.name: Molt
molt.desc: The user sheds its skin or exoskeleton, healing by 50% of their max HP. Z-Effect gives +1 Speed.

spectralshroud.name: Spectral Shroud
spectralshroud.desc: The user surrounds itself with spiritual energy, protecting itself. These spirits will disable any attacks that targeted the user. Z: Follow Me.

snatch.name: Snatch
snatch.desc: The user steals the effects of any attempts to use a healing, stat-changing or other similar moves. +6 Priority. Z-Effect gives +3 Speed.

secretpower.name: Secret Power
secretpower.desc: This odd move has a 50% chance to do various things. The effect changes based on your surroundings, including Psychic, Electric, Misty and Grassy Terrain.

dive.name: Dive
dive.desc: The user dives beneath the water, carefully lining up a precise strike before surfacing. Boosts Accuracy, can't miss, bypasses Protect.

forcepalm.name: Force Palm
forcepalm.desc: The user hits the foe hard with open palms, stunning the foe with a small shockwave.This ALWAYS paralyzes the foe.

camouflage.name: Camouflage
camouflage.desc: The user changes type depending on the environment, including the four different battle terrains. +2 Priority. Z-Effect +1 all stats.

powerglow.name: Power Glow
powerglow.desc: The user glows or lights up, boosting Sp. Atk by 3. With Z-Power, this light makes the user the center of attention.

scaleshot.name: Scale Shot
scaleshot.desc: The user fires its scales in rapid succession, hitting 2-5 times. Drops both defensive stats by -1 in exchange for +1 Speed after use.

featherflurry.name: Feather Flurry
featherflurry.desc: The user launches a stunning flurry of feathers towards the opponent, slowing them down. Drops Speed by 1 stage.

featherdance.name: Feather Dance
featherdance.desc: The user performs a display with its feathers, dropping the foe's guard. This lowers the target's Attack by 2. Z-Effect +2 crit rate.

teeterdance.name: Teeter Dance
teeterdance.desc: The user performs a wobbly dance, confusing itself in the process. With the help of Z-Power, this grants +1 to all stats.

blazekick.name: Blaze Kick
blazekick.desc: The user launches a blazing kick into the target. This ALWAYS burns the target.

mudslide.name: Mudslide
mudslide.desc: The user rides a wave of mud while retreating. For 10 turns, mud moves are boosted by 1.3x, and Electric moves are reduced by 2/3. Z: Heals replacement.

icetomb.name: Ice Tomb
icetomb.desc: The user crushes the target beneath a heavy mass of ice, lowering its Speed by 2 stages.

thornthrust.name: Thorn Thrust
thornthrust.desc: The user fires a barrage of thorns, scattering spikes. Hits 2-5 times. +4 Priority on the first turn only. Sets 1 layer of Spikes per battle.

slackoff.name: Slack Off
slackoff.desc: Lazing around, the user restores its own HP by half of its max HP. This heals 2/3 HP if the user has Comatose. Z-Effect +1 Defense.

hypervoice.name: Hyper Voice
hypervoice.desc: The user lets loose a horrible, resounding sound wave or cry. This has a 30% flinch rate.

poisonfang.name: Poison Fang
poisonfang.desc: The user bites down, with its unsanitary germs infecting the foe. This has a 50% chance to badly poison.

jaggededge.name: Jagged Edge
jaggededge.desc: The target is slashed violently with jagged claws, blades, or the like. This has a 50% (+2) crit rate.

blastburn.name: Blast Burn
blastburn.desc: The target is razed by an intense fiery blast. This drops the user's Sp. Atk by 2 after use, however.

hydrocannon.name: Hydro Cannon
hydrocannon.desc: The target is seized by a watery blast. This drops the user's Sp. Atk by 2 after use, however.

meteormash.name: Meteor Mash
meteormash.desc: The user punches with cosmic energy and the force of a meteor. This has a 30% chance to boost Attack.

spook.name: Spook
spook.desc: The user quickly jumpscares the target. This has +1 Priority.

weatherball.name: Weather Ball
weatherball.desc: The user fires off a ball of energy that changes type & doubles in power based on the weather. This drops Sp. Def 50% of the time.

aromatherapy.name: Aromatherapy
aromatherapy.desc: The user guards its side of the field with a calming, protective force. This blocks all stat drops on their side for 10 turns. Z-Heals.

faketears.name: Fake Tears
faketears.desc: The user feigns crying, flustering the target. This lowers their Sp. Def and Speed by 1. Z-Effect +1 Sp. Atk.

aircutter.name: Air Cutter
aircutter.desc: The user slashes at the air, damaging the opponents with a blade of wind. This has a 20% flinch rate, and ALWAYS crits.

overheat.name: Overheat
overheat.desc: The user's excess body heat is burned up in a powerful attack. This deals 30% recoil damage, and has a 30% chance to burn.

sniffout.name: Sniff Out
sniffout.desc: The user sniffs out the target's item- preventing them from using it for 15 turns, and switching out to a party member afterwards. Z: Heals replacement.

rocktomb.name: Rock Tomb
rocktomb.desc: The user hurls rocks to hit and surround the target, entrapping them. This ALWAYS lowers Speed by 2 stages.

pollenpuff.name: Pollen Puff
pollenpuff.desc: The user blows pollen at the opponent, sweeping away all of its stat changes. If used on an ally, this heals them by 50% HP.

metallicnoise.name: Metallic Noise
metallicnoise.desc: The user produces a deafening metallic screech that overwhelms the target, lowering Sp. Def by 1 stage.

grasswhistle.name: Grass Whistle
grasswhistle.desc: The user plays a soothing melody with blades of grass, putting the foe to sleep for 2 turns. Z-Effect center of attention.

tickle.name: Tickle
tickle.desc: The user tickles the target, lowering its Attack and Defense by 1. Z-Effect gives +1 Attack.

cosmicpower.name: Cosmic Power
cosmicpower.desc: The user absorbs mystic energy from space to raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats by 1. Z-Effect gives +1 Sp. Atk.

waterspout.name: Water Spout
waterspout.desc: The user attacks the foes with a massive spout of water. The lower the user's HP, the lower this move's power. 150 BP if full HP.

signalbeam.name: Signal Beam
signalbeam.desc: The user attacks with a peculiar, flashing beam. This ALWAYS confuses the target for 5 turns.

shadowpunch.name: Shadow Punch
shadowpunch.desc: The user throws a punch from the shadows. This can't miss, and bypasses substitute. 30% flinch rate.

extrasensory.name: Extrasensory
extrasensory.desc: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. This has a 30% flinch rate.

skyuppercut.name: Sky Uppercut
skyuppercut.desc: The user attacks with an uppercut thrown skyward with force. This deals super-effective damage on Flying types.

sandvortex.name: Sand Vortex
sandvortex.desc: The user engulfs the target in a violent vortex of swirling sand. Traps for 6 turns, dealing 1/8th per turn. 50% stronger in sand.

sheercold.name: Sheer Cold
sheercold.desc: The user exposes the target to intensely frigid air. This ALWAYS crits, but can't be used 2x in a row.

mudshower.name: Mud Shower
mudshower.desc: The user drenches opponents in a torrential shower of mud. This never misses while raining.

bulletseed.name: Bullet Seed
bulletseed.desc: Hard seeds are forcefully shot at the target in rapid succession. This hit 2-5 times in a row.

aerialace.name: Aerial Ace
aerialace.desc: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This has +1 Priority.

iciclespear.name: Icicle Spear
iciclespear.desc: The user shoots sharp icicles at the foe in succession. Hits 2-5 times.

irondefense.name: Iron Defense
irondefense.desc: The user hardens its body's surface to iron-like hardness. This raises Defense by 2. Z-Effect heals user fully.

enchantment.name: Enchantment
enchantment.desc: The user casts a spell on the opponents, turning them into a pure Psychic type. Z-Effect +1 Sp. Atk.

howl.name: Howl
howl.desc: The user howls to raise the spirits of itself and allies. This boosts both offensive stats by 1, as well as Speed with Z-Power.

savageslash.name: Savage Slash
savageslash.desc: The user ferociously slashes the target. This has a 50% (+2) crit rate.

frenzyplant.name: Frenzy Plant
frenzyplant.desc: The user assaults the target with roots from below in a frenzy. This lowers the user's Attack by 2 after use.

bulkup.name: Bulk Up
bulkup.desc: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body. This raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1. Z-Effect gives +2 Crit Rate. -1 Priority.

bounce.name: Bounce
bounce.desc: The user bounces up high, dropping on the next turn. Has a 30% chance to paralyze, boosts accuracy & bypasses Protect.

mudbarrage.name: Mud Barrage
mudbarrage.desc: The user pelts the target with globs of mud 3 times in succession.

poisontail.name: Poison Tail
poisontail.desc: The user batters the target with a tail steeped in poison. This has a 30% chance to poison, & a 30% flinch rate.

covet.name: Covet
covet.desc: The user endearingly approaches, then steals the foe's held item while attacking. No steal if user has item. 1.5x boost if item is stolen.

volttackle.name: Volt Tackle
volttackle.desc: The user charges the foe aggressively while electrified. This deals 30% recoil, and has a 30% chance to paralyze.

magicalleaf.name: Magical Leaf
magicalleaf.desc: The user summons ennchanted leaves to swirl around the target. Drops both of the foe's offensive stats once per target.

washaway.name: Wash Away
washaway.desc: The user summons a downpour of rain before switching places with a party member. -6 Priority. Z-Effect heals replacement.

calmmind.name: Calm Mind
calmmind.desc: The user focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats by 1. Z-Effect gives +2 Crit Rate. -1 Priority.

leafblade.name: Leaf Blade
leafblade.desc: The user vicously slashes the foe with a blade made of leaves. This has a +2 (+50%) crit rate.

dragondance.name: Dragon Dance
dragondance.desc: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that raises its Attack, Sp. Atk and Speed by 1. Z-Effect +1 accuracy. -1 priority.

rockblast.name: Rock Blast
rockblast.desc: The user shoots multiple hard rocks at the target. This hits 2-5 times in a row.

shockwave.name: Shock Wave
shockwave.desc: The user shocks the foe with a rapid jolt of electricity. This has +1 Priority.

waterpulse.name: Water Pulse
waterpulse.desc: The user attacks with a beautiful pulse of water. This ALWAYS leaves the opponent confused for 5 turns.

doomdesire.name: Doom Desire
doomdesire.desc: The user yearns for the target's demise, striking the target with a blast of dark energy 2 turns after the move is used.

psychoboost.name: Psycho Boost
psychoboost.desc: The user unleashes a massive blast of psychic energy at the foe. This drops the user's Sp. Atk by 2 after use, however.

roost.name: Roost
roost.desc: The user lands and rests its body, healing the user by 50% of its max HP. Removes Flying type for the turn. Z-Effect +1 Defense.

gravity.name: Gravity
gravity.desc: The user itensifies gravity for 5 turns, grounding all Pokemon as well as increasing accuracy by 1.67 and more. 10 turns w/Lunar Aura. Z-Effect: +1 Sp. Atk.

piercinggaze.name: Piercing Gaze
piercinggaze.desc: The user stuns the target with their eyes- causing them to flinch. +4 Priority. Only works turn 1. Matches the type of the user.

shroomsmack.name: Shroom Smack
shroomsmack.desc: Breloom stretches its arms to smack- startling the foe and scattering spores. 1.5x+Wakes if Asleep. Sets Leech Seed AND flinches.

hammerarm.name: Hammer Arm
hammerarm.desc: The user slams its heavy fist down onto the foe. This lowers the user's Speed by 1.

gyroball.name: Gyro Ball
gyroball.desc: The user rolls into the target at low speed, then uses its momentum to roll back & switch places with a party member. -6 priority.

rainbowveil.name: Rainbow Veil
rainbowveil.desc: A wondrous wall of light halves damage from ALL attacks for 5 turns. Only works in rain OR sun. Critical hits no longer ignore this. Z-Effect: Fully heals the user.

chillingwater.name: Chilling Water
chillingwater.desc: The user douses the foe with cold water, weakening them. Drops both of the foe's offensive stats once per target.

naturalgift.name: Natural Gift
naturalgift.desc: The user draws energy from its held berry. The type of this varies depending on the held berry. Uses whichever stat is higher.

thinkfast.name: Think Fast
thinkfast.desc: The user outmanuevers the foe with its intellect, hitting them faster than they can think. +1 Priority, and lifts/ignores protect.

pluck.name: Pluck
pluck.desc: The user picks at the target. If the target is holding a berry, this is 50% stronger and eats the berry, gaining the effect. 30% flinch.

tailwind.name: Tailwind
tailwind.desc: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that doubles the Speed stat of your party for 5 turns, or 8 turns with Wind Rider. Z-Effect +1 Acc.

pressurepoint.name: Pressure Point
pressurepoint.desc: The user strikes the target's pressure points, disrupting its body. This paralyzes them while lowering offensive stats. Z-Effect +1 Attack.

metalburst.name: Metal Burst
metalburst.desc: The user moves last, hardening its body before dealing 1.5x damage taken back to the target with a burst attack.

uturn.name: U-turn
uturn.desc: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a different Pokemon.

closecombat.name: Close Combat
closecombat.desc: The user aggresively attacks the foe up close, without guarding itself. This deals 30% recoil to the user.

payback.name: Payback
payback.desc: The user readies itself, then violently retaliates at the foe. This usually moves last. (-5 Priority)

assurance.name: Assurance
assurance.desc: The user takes advantage of an injured target. Its power doubles if the target has already taken any damage this turn.

lockdown.name: Lockdown
lockdown.desc: The user ensnares the foe in chains before it can react. +4 Priority, crits+flinches, only works turn 1, & blocks the foe's item for 15 turns.

fling.name: Fling
fling.desc: The user quickly throws its item. +4 Priority, ALWAYS flinches. Iron Ball 100 BP. Flame/Toxic Orb & Light Ball 60 BP + Status.

statusshift.name: Status Shift
statusshift.desc: The user transfers any status conditions it has to the target. Z-Effect heals user to full. This has +4 Priority.

royalflush.name: Royal Flush
royalflush.desc: The user bets it all on a winning hand, striking 3 times with a 50% crit rate. Matches the user's type, and uses their higher stat.

healblock.name: Heal Block
healblock.desc: The user disables any healing or draining moves the target may have for 3 turns. Z-Effect heals to full.

chromosomecrush.name: Chromosome Crush
chromosomecrush.desc: Using its psychic prowess, the user breaks the DNA structure of the target. 120 BP if the opponent is full HP. Much weaker if less HP.

powertrick.name: Power Trick
powertrick.desc: The user swaps its Attack stat with its Defense stat. Z-Effect +1 Attack.

acidreflux.name: Acid Reflux
acidreflux.desc: The user upchucks, covering the foe in corrosive stomach acid. This lowers the foe's Sp. Def by 2 stages and poisons them. Z-Effect: Fully heals the user.

luckychant.name: Lucky Chant
luckychant.desc: The user shields their team from critical hits for 7 turns. If the user has Super Luck, this doubles.  +2 Priority. Z-Effect heals.

mefirst.name: Me First
mefirst.desc: The user steals the target's attempted move if it is faster, using it with 50% more power. +6 Priority. Z-Effect +1 Attack & uses Z-Move.

copycat.name: Copycat
copycat.desc: The user performs the most recently used move by any Pokemon. +6 Priority. Z-Effect +1 Attack.

powerswap.name: Power Swap
powerswap.desc: The user swaps offensive stat changes with the target. This has +4 priority. Z-Effect heals to full.

guardswap.name: Guard Swap
guardswap.desc: The user swaps defensive stat changes with the target. This has +4 priority. Z-Effect heals to full.

blindside.name: Blindside
blindside.desc: The user strikes from the target's blind spot before it can react. This has +4 priority and flinches, but only works on turn 1.

lastresort.name: Last Resort
lastresort.desc: This powerful, desperate attack can only be used if the user has used their other moves at least once.

worryseed.name: Worry Seed
worryseed.desc: A seed that causes anxiety is planted on the foe, turning the foe's ability into Insomnia. Z-Effect +1 Sp. Atk

suckerpunch.name: Sucker Punch
suckerpunch.desc: The user catches the target off guard, striking before they can. Fails if the foe isn't using an attacking move. This has +2 Priority.

toxicspikes.name: Toxic Spikes
toxicspikes.desc: The user lays toxic spikes around the foe's side, poisoning foes who switch in, with 2 layers badly poisoning. Z-Effect +1 Attack.

heartswap.name: Heart Swap
heartswap.desc: The user intertwines its heart with the target’s, swapping any changes to their stats. This has +4 priority. Z-Effect heals the user.

rehydrate.name: Rehydrate
rehydrate.desc: The user replenishes its fluids, hydrating itself. Heals 50% HP. Heals 2/3 in the rain, and 1/3 in the sun. Z-Effect: +1 Sp. Def.

magnetrise.name: Magnet Rise
magnetrise.desc: The user manipulates magnetic fields to levitate off the ground for 5 turns. Z-Effect +1 Speed.

flareblitz.name: Flare Blitz
flareblitz.desc: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges full-force at the target. Deals 30% recoil damage, has 30% burn rate.

forcewaves.name: Force Waves
forcewaves.desc: The user forms 2 shockwaves from its palms. This hits twice, and each hit has a 30% paralysis chance.

aurasphere.name: Aura Sphere
aurasphere.desc: The user lets loose a blast of aura power from deep within itself. This has a 20% chance to drop Sp. Def by 1.

rockpolish.name: Rock Polish
rockpolish.desc: The user polishes its body, reducing drag. This raises the user's Speed and Accuracy by 2. Z-Effect gives +2 Crit Rate.

poisonjab.name: Poison Jab
poisonjab.desc: The foe is stabbed with an arm or appendage steeped in poison. This poisons 30% of the time.

darkpulse.name: Dark Pulse
darkpulse.desc: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark energy. This flinches 20% of the time, & inflicts a nightmare on a sleeping foe.

nightslash.name: Night Slash
nightslash.desc: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. This has a 50% (+2) crit rate.

aquatail.name: Aqua Tail
aquatail.desc: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a wave in a raging storm. LDefense 30% of the time.

seedbomb.name: Seed Bomb
seedbomb.desc: The user rains a volley of hard-shelled seeds down on the target. This flinches the target 20% of the time.

airslash.name: Air Slash
airslash.desc: The user attacks with a powerful blade of air. 50% (+2) crit rate. 30% flinch rate.

xscissor.name: X-Scissor
xscissor.desc: The user slashes at the foe by crossing its scythes, claws or the like. This has a 50% (+2) crit rate.

bugbuzz.name: Bug Buzz
bugbuzz.desc: The user generates a devastating sound wave with vibration. This flinches the foes 30% of the time.

dragonpulse.name: Dragon Pulse
dragonpulse.desc: The user releases a destructive shockwave of dragon energy. This ALWAYS lowers the Sp. Def of the target by 1 stage.

dragonrush.name: Dragon Rush
dragonrush.desc: The user tackles the foe with overwhelming menace. Deals 30% recoil damage. 30% flinch rate.

powergem.name: Power Gem
powergem.desc: The user attacks with a ray of light like gemstones. This has a 25% chance to raise the user's Sp. Atk by 1.

drainpunch.name: Drain Punch
drainpunch.desc: The user attacks the foe with an energy-draining punch. This heals the user by 50% of damage dealt.

vacuumwave.name: Vacuum Wave
vacuumwave.desc: The user creates a wave of pure vacuum and sends it at the foe. This has +1 Priority.

focusblast.name: Focus Blast
focusblast.desc: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes a massive blast of aura energy. This ALWAYS lowers the foe's Sp. Def.

energyball.name: Energy Ball
energyball.desc: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This has a 25% chance to drop the foe's Sp. Def by 1.

bravebird.name: Brave Bird
bravebird.desc: The user tucks its body in and charges from a low altitude. This has 30% recoil, & a 30% chance to lower the foe's Defense by 1.

earthpower.name: Earth Power
earthpower.desc: The user makes the ground under the target erupt. This has a 30% chance to drop the foe's Sp. Def.

engorge.name: Engorge
engorge.desc: The user gorges itself, eating its held berry. This heals to FULL HP, on top of the berry's actual effect. Z-Effect: Center of attention.

gigaimpact.name: Giga Impact
gigaimpact.desc: The user charges with incredible force, using all of its strength. This drops the user's Attack by 2 after use.

nastyplot.name: Nasty Plot
nastyplot.desc: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This raises Sp. Atk by 2. Z-Effect gives +1 Accuracy. -1 Priority.

bulletpunch.name: Bullet Punch
bulletpunch.desc: The user strikes the target with a punch as fast & hard as a bullet. This has +1 Priority.

avalanche.name: Avalanche
avalanche.desc: The user readies itself, then summons a devastating avalanche. This usually moves last. (-5 Priority.) 25% boost in a snowstorm.

iceshard.name: Ice Shard
iceshard.desc: The user flash-freezes shards of ice and shoots them at the foe. This has +1 Priority.

shadowslash.name: Shadow Slash
shadowslash.desc: The user slashes with a sharp claw or blade made from shadows. This has a +2 (50%) crit rate.

thunderfang.name: Thunder Fang
thunderfang.desc: The user bites the foe with electrified fangs. This has a 25% flinch rate, and a 10% chance to paralyze the foe.

icefang.name: Ice Fang
icefang.desc: The user bites the foe with frozen fangs. This has a 20% flinch rate, and a 10% chance to freeze the foe.

firefang.name: Fire Fang
firefang.desc: The user bites the foe with flaming fangs. This has a 20% flinch rate, and a 10% chance to burn the foe.

shadowsneak.name: Shadow Sneak
shadowsneak.desc: The user sneaks behind the foe, striking from the shadows. This has +1 Priority, & bypasses substitute.

mudbomb.name: Mud Bomb
mudbomb.desc: The user hurls a heavy mass of mud that explodes all over the target. 30% flinch rate.

psychocut.name: Psycho Cut
psychocut.desc: The user tears at the target with psychic powered blades. This has a +2 (50%) crit rate.

zenheadbutt.name: Zen Headbutt
zenheadbutt.desc: The user focuses its willpower to its head and charges the foe. This flinches 30% of the time.

mirrorshot.name: Mirror Shot
mirrorshot.desc: The user lets loose a flash of light from its body, disorienting the targets. Lowers offensive stats by 1, once per target.

flashcannon.name: Flash Cannon
flashcannon.desc: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it in a powerful beam. This has a 50% chance to confuse & deals 30% recoil.

craggycrash.name: Craggy Crash
craggycrash.desc: The user crashes into the foe with the force of a tumbling boulder. Deals 20% recoil, and has a 30% chance to confuse.

smokeout.name: Smoke Out
smokeout.desc: The user fills the area with a concealing fog before dispersing it- switching out. Clears stat changes/hazards & lowers evasion by -6. Z: Heals replacement.

trickroom.name: Trick Room
trickroom.desc: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokemon move first for 5 turns. NEUTRAL priority. Z-Effect resets lowered stats.

dracometeor.name: Draco Meteor
dracometeor.desc: Comets are summoned down from the sky onto the target. Drops the user's Sp. Atk by 2 after. 1.5x in Lunar Aura and Gravity. (Stacks)

overload.name: Overload
overload.desc: The user overwhelms the targets with a loud surge of electricity. 30% chance to paralyze, and doubles in power if already paralyzed.

afterburner.name: Afterburner
afterburner.desc: The user scorches the target, causing the target's burns to flare up. This has a 30% burn rate and doubles damage if already burnt.

leafstorm.name: Leaf Storm
leafstorm.desc: The user whips up a massive storm of leaves around the foe. This lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2 after use.

powerwhip.name: Power Whip
powerwhip.desc: The user violently uses its vines, tentacles or the like to lash the foe. This ALWAYS lowers the target's Defense by 1.

rockwrecker.name: Rock Wrecker
rockwrecker.desc: The user launches a colossal boulder with enough force to crush anything. Lowers the user’s Attack by 2 after use, however.

crosspoison.name: Cross Poison
crosspoison.desc: The user slashes with poisonous blades, claws or the like. This has a 50% (+2) crit rate and poisons 20% of the time.

gunkshot.name: Gunk Shot
gunkshot.desc: The user shoots filthy, dense gunk at the target with great force. This ALWAYS crits & poisons, but can't be used 2x in a row.

ironhead.name: Iron Head
ironhead.desc: The user rams the target with its steel-hard head. This flinches the target 30% of the time.

magnetbomb.name: Magnet Bomb
magnetbomb.desc: The user launches a magnetized explosive that is drawn toward conductive targets. Super effective against Electric AND Steel types.

stoneedge.name: Stone Edge
stoneedge.desc: The user stabs the target with pointed stones from below. This ALWAYS crits, but can't be used 2x in a row.

captivate.name: Captivate
captivate.desc: If any opposing Pokemon is the opposite gender of the user, it is charmed, which lowers it's Attack and Sp. Atk by 2. Z-Effect +2 Sp. Def.

stealthrock.name: Stealth Rock
stealthrock.desc: The user lays floating stones around the foe's side, damaging foes based on their weakness to Rock. Z-Effect gives +1 Defense.

grassknot.name: Grass Knot
grassknot.desc: The user snares and trips the target with grass, lowering their Speed by 2. The heavier the foe, the stronger it is. Uses higher stat.

chatter.name: Chatter
chatter.desc: Chatot flies around creating a ruckus. This confuses all foes AND itself- for 15 turns. 30% flinch. +4 priority on turn 1 only.

scorchedearth.name: Scorched Earth
scorchedearth.desc: The user calls down an onslaught from above that crashes into the target and razes the earth around it, leaving them with a burn.

bugbiting.name: Bug Biting
bugbiting.desc: The user nibbles at the foe. Hits twice, & if the foe has a berry, this is 50% stronger & steals the berry effect. 15% flinch rate per hit.

chargebeam.name: Charge Beam
chargebeam.desc: The user fires off a beam of electricity to attack while charging energy. This ALWAYS raises the user's Sp. Atk by 1 after use.

woodhammer.name: Wood Hammer
woodhammer.desc: The user powerfully slams the target with a tree.This deals 30% recoil to the user, and flinches 30% of the time.

aquajet.name: Aqua Jet
aquajet.desc: The user quickly surges in the water towards the opponent. This has +1 Priority.

attackorder.name: Attack Order
attackorder.desc: Vespiquen commands its swarm to assault the opponents. This ALWAYS crits, but the assault may miss its mark occasionally.

defendorder.name: Defend Order
defendorder.desc: Vespiquen commands its swarm to immediately form a protective formation, boosting Defense by 2. +2 Priority. Z-Effect +1 Sp. Def.

healorder.name: Heal Order
healorder.desc: Vespiquen commands its swarm to gather restorative jelly. Their aid arrives at the end of the next turn, healing the user or ally by 50%. Z-Effect: +1 Sp. Atk.

headsmash.name: Head Smash
headsmash.desc: The user throws its entire body into a devastating headfirst charge. Deals 50% recoil damage, and has a 30% flinch rate.

wallop.name: Wallop
wallop.desc: The user strikes the target playfully. This hits 2-5 times in a row.

auroraburst.name: Aurora Burst
auroraburst.desc: The user unleashes a dazzling burst of freezing energy fueled from its own body. This deals 30% recoil, and ALWAYS drops Sp. Def.

subspacetear.name: Subspace Tear
subspacetear.desc: The user rips open a tear in reality. This ALWAYS crits- but cannot be used 2x in a row.

lunarblessing.name: Lunar Blessing
lunarblessing.desc: The user departs under the moon’s blessing, leaving its light behind to heal the Pokemon that takes its place by 50%. Z-Effect: Fully heals the user.

titansgrip.name: Titan's Grip
titansgrip.desc: Regigigas seizes the foe in its mighty grip and drains 50% damage. The more HP the target has, the greater the damage, maxing at 120.

magmastorm.name: Magma Storm
magmastorm.desc: The target becomes trapped within a maelstrom of fire for 12 turns, preventing switching & dealing 12% of their HP per turn.

darkvoid.name: Dark Void
darkvoid.desc: Darkrai traps the foes in a world of darkness, putting them to sleep for 2 turns. Z-Effect resets lowered stats.

seedflare.name: Seed Flare
seedflare.desc: The user emits a destructive blast from within itself. This has a 50% chance to drop the foe's Sp. Def by 2, and deals 30% recoil.

wailingwinds.name: Wailing Winds
wailingwinds.desc: The user unleashes an ominous gale of wind imbued with haunting echoes. This ALWAYS crits.

shadowbreak.name: Shadow Break
shadowbreak.desc: The user disappears, then suddenly re-appears, striking with immense force in 1 turn. Bypasses substitute & protect. 30% recoil.

sharpen.name: Sharpen
sharpen.desc: The user sharpens its claws, blades or body. This boosts the user's Attack by 1, and Accuracy by 6. Z-Effect +2 Crit Rate.

psychoshield.name: Psycho Shield
psychoshield.desc: The user puts up a forcefield to block all spread moves. Can be used consecutively. Z-Effect makes the user center of attention.

guardsplit.name: Guard Split
guardsplit.desc: The user averages defensive stats with the target. This has +4 priority. Z-Effect heals the user fully.

powersplit.name: Power Split
powersplit.desc: The user averages offensive stats with the target. This has +4 priority. Z-Effect heals to full.

wonderroom.name: Wonder Room
wonderroom.desc: For 5 turns, the Sp. Def & Defense stats are swapped for all Pokemon on the field. +5 Priority. Z-Effect +2 Sp. Def.

psyshock.name: Psyshock
psyshock.desc: The user materializes an odd psychic force to attack. This move deals Physical damage to the target.

venoshock.name: Venoshock
venoshock.desc: The user sends a surge of venom coursing through the target. 30% chance to Poison. Doubles if the target is poisoned.

autotomize.name: Autotomize
autotomize.desc: The user sheds its body, making itself lighter. Grants +3 Speed in exchange for 25% of the user's HP. Z-Effect gives another +1 Speed.

ragepowder.name: Rage Powder
ragepowder.desc: The user scatters irritating powder, drawing attention to itself, making all opponents only attack the user. Z-Effect +2 Sp. Def.

telekinesis.name: Telekinesis
telekinesis.desc: The target is suspended in the air. This makes them immune to ground, and all moves will hit. Lasts until switched out. Z+1 Sp. Atk.

magicroom.name: Magic Room
magicroom.desc: For 5 turns, held items have no effect for all Pokemon on the field. ALWAYS goes first. Z-Effect heals to full.

smackdown.name: Smack Down
smackdown.desc: The user slams the target down hard with a rock. 30% flinch rate. A flying/levitating Pokemon will fall and be grounded when hit.

stormthrow.name: Storm Throw
stormthrow.desc: The user throws the target violently. This ALWAYS results in a critical hit.

burstingflames.name: Bursting Flames
burstingflames.desc: The user attacks the foe with a flurry of flames. This hits 3 times, & hurts the Pokemon next to the foe, dealing 18% of their max HP.

sludgewave.name: Sludge Wave
sludgewave.desc: The user swamps the field with sludge. Poisons 30% of the time. Cannot miss if it's raining.

quiverdance.name: Quiver Dance
quiverdance.desc: The user lightly performs a mystic dance, quivering its body or wings. This boosts Sp. Atk, Sp. Def & Speed by 1. -1 Priority. Z-Effect: +1 Accuracy.

heavyslam.name: Heavy Slam
heavyslam.desc: The user slams its massive body into the foe with crushing force. Deals 30% recoil to the user, & paralyzes 30% of the time.

psychicnoise.name: Psychic Noise
psychicnoise.desc: The user unleashes a sound-wave powered by psychic energy. This ALWAYS confuses those who are hit for 3 turns.

bodypress.name: Body Press
bodypress.desc: The user slams its body firmly into the foe. This uses the Defense stat instead of Attack to deal damage.

soak.name: Soak
soak.desc: The user soaks the foe in water, turning it into a pure Water-type. Z-Effect +1 Sp. Atk.

pyrodash.name: Pyro Dash
pyrodash.desc: The user quickly dashes at the target while cloaked in flame. This has +1 Priority.

coil.name: Coil
coil.desc: The user curls up its long body. This boosts Attack, Defense and Accuracy by 1. Z-Effect gives +2 Crit Rate. -1 Priority.

lowsweep.name: Low Sweep
lowsweep.desc: The user makes a swift attack at the foe using its legs. This has a 30% flinch rate.

sludgeshot.name: Sludge Shot
sludgeshot.desc: The user shoots filthy liquid at the foe faster than they can react. This has +1 Priority.

foulplay.name: Foul Play
foulplay.desc: This devious attack uses the target's strength against itself, using the target's Attack stat instead of their own.

simplebeam.name: Simple Beam
simplebeam.desc: The user fires a mind-numbing beam, making the target dimwitted. Changes the target's ability to Simple. Z-Effect heals user fully.

entrainment.name: Entrainment
entrainment.desc: The user influences the target, changing the target's ability to match the user's. Z-Effect +1 Attack.

flipturn.name: Flip Turn
flipturn.desc: The user performs a fluid maneuver through the water before retreating to switch places with a party member.

cacaphony.name: Cacaphony
cacaphony.desc: The user lets out a disorienting noise. Others can join in to increase the power. Lowers the foe's offensive stats, once per target.

echoedvoice.name: Echoed Voice
echoedvoice.desc: The user lets out a harsh, echoing shout. This hits twice, and always confuses for 3 turns.

skittersmack.name: Skitter Smack
skittersmack.desc: The user skitters around erratically before attacking, disorienting the foe. Drops both of the foe's offensive stats by 1 once per target.

mistball.name: Mist Ball
mistball.desc: The user fires of a ball of pure mist at the foe, clearing all of their stat changes. In Misty Terrain, this gains +1 priority.

mysticalpower.name: Mystical Power
mysticalpower.desc: Will be finalized/revealed once the boss fight guide is filled out.

quickguard.name: Quick Guard
quickguard.desc: The user guards its side of the field from all targeted priority moves. Z-Effect gives +2 Speed.

allyswitch.name: Ally Switch
allyswitch.desc: The user switches places with an ally. This has +6 priority. Z-Effect +3 Speed.

scald.name: Scald
scald.desc: The user shoots boiling water at the foe. This ALWAYS burns the target. Boosted by 50% in Sun.

shellsmash.name: Shell Smash
shellsmash.desc: The user smashes its shell, lowering its defensive stats by 1, & raising Speed & offensive stats by 2. Z-Effect additional +1 Speed.

healpulse.name: Heal Pulse
healpulse.desc: The user emits a restorative wave which heals itself and an ally by 50% HP. Z-Effect heals the user to full.

hex.name: Hex
hex.desc: This sinister attack deals double damage to a foe with a status condition.

skydrop.name: Sky Drop
skydrop.desc: The user takes time to haul the target high into the sky before letting go and sending it plummeting to the ground. -5 Priority.

shiftgear.name: Shift Gear
shiftgear.desc: The user rotates its internal mechanisms. This raises Attack and Sp. Atk by 1, & Speed by 2. Z-Effect +3 Accuracy. -1 Priority.

circlethrow.name: Circle Throw
circlethrow.desc: The target is thrown out of battle, forced to swap out into a random teammate. This attack ALWAYS goes last. (-7 Priority)

heattransfer.name: Heat Transfer
heattransfer.desc: The user absorbs the target's body heat to heal itself. This heals 75% of damage dealt.

quash.name: Quash
quash.desc: The user overwhelms the target, forcing it to move last this turn. This has +4 priority. Z-Effect makes the user center of attention.

acrobatics.name: Acrobatics
acrobatics.desc: The user nimbly strikes the target. If the user isn't holding an item, this attack doubles in power.

reflecttype.name: Reflect Type
reflecttype.desc: The user becomes the same exact type as the target. +2 Priority. Z-Effect gives +1 all stats.

retaliate.name: Retaliate
retaliate.desc: The user violently retaliates at the foe. If an ally fainted in the previous turn, this move's power is doubled.

finalgambit.name: Final Gambit
finalgambit.desc: The user puts its life on the line, fainting itself to deal the remainder of its HP in damage towards the opponent.

tripleaxel.name: Triple Axel
tripleaxel.desc: The user executes three consecutive frozen strikes against the target while spinning. Hits 3x guaranteed.

wildfire.name: Wildfire
wildfire.desc: The target is swamped in a sea of fierce flames. This ALWAYS crits, but can't be used 2x in a row. 30% burn rate.

waterpledge.name: Water Pledge
waterpledge.desc: A column of water damages the foe. This can be combined with another pledge. Z-Effect heals to full HP.

firepledge.name: Fire Pledge
firepledge.desc: A column of fire damages the foe. This can be combined with another pledge. Z-Effect heals the user to full.

grasspledge.name: Grass Pledge
grasspledge.desc: A column of grass damages the foe. This can be combined with another pledge in doubles. Z-Effect heals to full.

voltswitch.name: Volt Switch
voltswitch.desc: The user fires a jolt of electricity, then rushes back to switch places with an ally.

strugglebug.name: Struggle Bug
strugglebug.desc: While resisting, the user attacks the opposing Pokemon. Drops both of the foe's offensive stats once per target.

bulldoze.name: Bulldoze
bulldoze.desc: The user shakes up the ground beneath those nearby, disrupting their footing and lowering their Speed by 2 stages.

frostbreath.name: Frost Breath

photongeyser.desc: The user unleashes a devastating burst of light from within. Uses higher stat. Super-effective on Dark types. 50% recoil.

lightthatburnsthesky.name: Light That Burns the Sky
lightthatburnsthesky.desc: This attack inflicts Attack or Sp. Atk damage, whichever stat is higher for the user  This move ignores the target’s Ability.

searingsunrazesmash.name: Searing Sunraze Smash
searingsunrazesmash.desc: Solgaleo crashes down with the full force of the sun. Super-effective on Fire types. Deals 50% recoil.

menacingmoonrazemaelstrom.name: Menacing Moonraze Maelstrom
menacingmoonrazemaelstrom.desc: Lunala channels the full power of the moon. Deals super-effective damage on Fairy types, and ignores abilities. 50% recoil.

letssnuggleforever.name: Let’s Snuggle Forever
letssnuggleforever.desc: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Mimikyu, punches the target with full force.

splinteredstormshards.name: Splintered Stormshards
splinteredstormshards.desc: Lycanroc unleashes a devastating onslaught of stones that tear through the target, scattering pointed stones on the foe's side.

clangoroussoulblaze.name: Clangorous Soulblaze
clangoroussoulblaze.desc: Kommo-o riles itself up with a fierce dance before unleashing a devastating sonic blast. Raises Speed by 1, but deals 50% recoil.
